attempt: Replace a generated asset ZIP at runtime while Hytale holds its ZIP filesystem open
reason_failed: Windows refused the active archive replacement with AccessDeniedException. Regeneration must not overwrite an asset pack already opened by AssetModule.
environment: Windows, Hytale 0.6.8, AdaptiveWindow material bake fixture
conditions: Active asset pack loaded from ZIP
Generated materials written during server lifetime
workaround: Write a complete separate pending ZIP, then atomically promote it during next plugin construction before AssetModule opens packs. Preserve old pack and states. Tested separate bake and next-start activation; complete user-client new-donor lifecycle not yet verified.

source_refs.description: Read previous pack, write separate complete pending ZIP
Early next-start promotion and backup of previous ZIP
